components.contagion: anisotropic CNN, elliptical-Gaussian init, wind/slope stretched
components.latent_z_t: PRESENT (M5/P2): 6-d shared per-step latent ['log_intensity', 'head_rotation', 'log_wind_speed', 'activity_gate', 'intensity_grad_east', 'intensity_grad_north'], N(0,I) prior, learned sigma, CVAE-style ELBO
components.ensemble: z_t ~ N(0, I) drawn ONCE PER MEMBER PER STEP and shared by every pixel; pixels are conditionally independent Bernoulli GIVEN (x_t, z_t)
components.susceptibility: mode=amplitude. 'amplitude' is the ADR-015 (6a) fix; 'reach' is M2's defect (zero gradient on barrier + non-burnable) and is a control only.
components.stage_scalar: ABSENT — this is ARM A, the incumbent kernel (S1 control).
